blocks.text: Group 1 (alkali metals) aur Group 2 (alkaline earth metals) dono mein bohat reactive metals hain, lekin ionization energies ke farq ki wajah se in mein ahem farq hain. Group 1 ki metals ke paas dene ke liye sirf ek electron hota hai, is liye woh react karne ke liye bohat tayyar hoti hain aur +1 ion banati hain. Group 2 ki metals do electrons deti hain, jis mein zyada energy lagti hai; is liye yeh reactive to hain magar usi period ki Group 1 metal se aam taur par kam. Dono groups mein neeche jate hue reactivity barhti hai, kyunke atom ka size barhta aur ionization energy kam hoti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Asal farq electrons ki tadaad ka hai: Group 1 ko ek electron dena hai, Group 2 ko do. Doosra electron nikalna mushkil hai (Table 17.1 mein 2nd ionization energy 1st se taqreeban doguni hai), is liye Group 2 metals kam reactive hain. Do electrons metallic bonding bhi mazboot karte hain, is liye Group 2 metals zyada sakht, zyada ghani (dense) aur zyada melting point wali hain.

blocks.prompt: Group 1 aur Group 2 metals ke do physical farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi do: Group 2 metals zyada sakht hain, in ki density zyada hai, aur in ke melting aur boiling points zyada hain.

items: Group 1: ek electron, +1 ion, zyada reactive, naram, M₂O.
Group 2: do electrons, +2 ion, kam reactive, sakht aur ghani, MO.
Dono groups mein reactivity neeche barhti hai.
